records.english: This month's tribute is %s gold coins. Please accept it.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: States this month's tribute amount in gold coins and politely asks the recipient to accept it.
records.speaker: Representative offering tribute
records.context: Complete native owners B0 R58-R62. For IDs 76-82, table 021189C0 is selected at 0202DE94; the preceding code subtracts tribute from the paying faction and credits the player before announcing it. お納めください means accept the offered tribute, not pay a bill. The separate two-argument town notice 83 shares R62: caller 020B25A8 reports an accumulated town total and passes the current player faction name before the amount. The player name editor allows eighteen bytes. Expanded native layout is reviewed; full widget composition and cold-boot gameplay remain pending.
records.localization_note: Fresh natural American English restores receiving direction, monthly timing and gold-coin units. Retains each source variant's politeness, hesitation, neutral statement or older invitation. records.english: Towns under %s's exclusive contracts paid %s gold coins in tribute.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Reports accumulated tribute from towns under the first named party's exclusive contracts, followed by the gold-coin amount. The Japanese town noun is not singular-marked; the native caller accumulates up to ninety town contributions and announces once per beneficiary. The first argument is the contract holder and the second is money.
